notes.title: Update on September 25, 2025
notes.content: [p]The voice in the opening movie has been changed.[/p]

notes.title: June 7 Update
notes.content: The opening scene can now be skipped using the F key.

notes.title: The second update on May 31st.
notes.content: We adjusted the texture resolution and slightly reduced the file size.

notes.title: Update for May 31th.
notes.content:
The following issues were corrected:

In Easy mode, the problem where the player becomes immobile upon touching an enemy.

The problem where the inventory does not display properly depending on the monitor in use.

The problem where the game behaves oddly depending on the PC in use.

notes.title: The second update of the day.
notes.content:
The following issues were corrected:

The problem where there was a snag when going underground.

The problem where touching an enemy after kicking them resulted in a game over.

notes.title: Update for May 30th.
notes.content:
The following points were corrected:
Some sentences were not translated into English.
The doll was slipping.
